import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

def build_rules(gaz):
    months = r"(?:January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)"
    rules = [
      ("EMAIL", re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@example\.com")),
      ("URL", re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"']+")),
      ("PHONE", re.compile(r"(?<!\d)555-01\d{2}(?!\d)")),
      ("IP", re.compile(r"(?<![\w.])(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}(?![\d.])")),
      ("RECORD_NUMBER", re.compile(r"(?<!\d)\d{9}(?!\d)")),
      ("DATE", re.compile("|".join([
         rf"{months}\s+\d{{1,2}},?\s+\d{{4}}",
         rf"\d{{1,2}}\s+{months}\s+\d{{4}}",
         r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}",
         r"\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}",
      ]))),
      ("ADDRESS", re.compile(r"(?<![\w,])\d{1,5}\s+[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+){0,2}\s+(?:Street|Avenue|Road|Lane|Boulevard|Court|Drive)\b")),
      ("LICENSE_PLATE", re.compile(r"(?<!\w)[A-Z]{3}\d{5}[A-Z]{3}(?!\w)")),
    ]
    names = sorted({f"{f} {l}" for f in gaz["first_names"] for l in gaz["last_names"]}, key=len, reverse=True)
    alt = "|".join(re.escape(n).replace(r"\ ", r"\s+") for n in names)
    rules.append(("NAME", re.compile(rf"(?<![A-Za-z])(?:{alt})(?![A-Za-z])")))
    return rules

def redact(text, rules):
    out = text; counts={}
    for cat, rx in rules:
        out, n = rx.subn(f"[{cat}]", out)
        if n: counts[cat]=counts.get(cat,0)+n
    return out, counts
